description: Boverket's API lets companies pull basic facts from Sweden's register of building energy declarations straight into their own systems. For a building it returns the energy class from A to G and A0, the declaration identifier, the energy performance as a primary energy number, specific energy use, whether radon measurement and ventilation inspection were done, and the date of the declaration. These basic items are free; laws limit what else may be shared, so no more fields are offered. Coverage: buildings in Sweden with an energy declaration. Access: free, but a company must sign an agreement digitally with BankID through Addo Sign before getting access; manual lookups use the separate search e-service. Licence: use under the Boverket agreement. Caveats: company access only and basic fields only; buildings without a declaration are missing. Simulation uses are building stock energy baselines, retrofit targeting and ventilation and radon checks for school and housing portfolios. Related records: the Lantmäteriet INSPIRE building download and the England and Wales EPC register.
